Thanks for the ping — I pulled the logs for org id 84271. Root cause: our promo-redemption webhook to the grant service experienced a transient 502 from the internal grants API and our retry backoff was too aggressive (we gave up after three attempts within the first minute). The grant record was never created, so the dashboard shows $0.

Workaround: I can trigger a one-off grant for RT-PLG-50 -> $50 credit against FastRetail (org 84271). I'll run the grant now and attach the minimal log snippet. I also pushed a quick config change to increase webhook retry attempts and added an alert if a redemption webhook fails more than 2 times in 10 minutes.

Short next steps:
- I'll run the manual grant now (should reflect in the dashboard within ~2-5 minutes).
- Ben/Hannah: please confirm with Julia once the balance shows up; I'll follow up with a permanent fix ticket for engineering.
